description: This file implements the DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer class which is a stream queue balancer that uses deployment information to balance queues across silos in an Orleans cluster. It manages silo statuses, distributes queues, and reacts to cluster membership changes to maintain balanced load distribution.

classes.name: DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer
classes.description: A queue balancer class that uses deployment configuration and silo statuses to distribute queues evenly across silos using a best fit algorithm.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer with given services, name, and deployment configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer with a queue mapper and sets up internal data structures.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues assigned to the current silo based on load balancing logic.
